title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 11: the flock of slaughter, the two staffs Favor and Union, and the thirty pieces of silver.

questions.text: What does the chapter call on Lebanon to open its doors for?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:1 tells Lebanon to open its doors so that the fire may devour its cedars.

questions.text: Which trees are told to wail because the strong forest has come down?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:2 tells the oaks of Bashan to wail, because the strong forest has come down.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell the speaker to do?
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 11:4 Yahweh says: Feed the flock of slaughter.

answers.text: Count the sheep of the flock
Build a sheepfold in the land

questions.text: What were the names of the two staffs the speaker took for himself?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:7 says he took two staffs, calling the one Favor and the other Union.

questions.text: How many shepherds did the speaker cut off, and in what time?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:8 says he cut off three shepherds in one month, for his soul was weary of them.

questions.text: Why did the speaker cut apart the staff Favor?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:10 says he cut apart the staff Favor so that he might break his covenant that he had made with all the peoples.

answers.text: To end the long famine in the land of Judah
To bring down the tall cedars of Lebanon
To break his covenant with all the peoples
To gather the flock that had been scattered

questions.text: What was weighed out as the speaker's wages?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:12 says that when he asked for his wages, they weighed for him thirty pieces of silver.

questions.text: Where did the speaker throw the thirty pieces of silver?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:13 says he took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter, in Yahweh's house.

answers.text: At the feet of the buyers
Into the treasury of the king
To the potter, in Yahweh's house

questions.text: What did cutting apart the other staff, Union, break?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:14 says he cut apart the staff Union so that he might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

answers.text: The siege of Jerusalem by the nations
The covenant of Levi and the priests
The brotherhood between Judah and Israel
The yoke of Assyria on the land

questions.text: What will happen to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:17 says the sword will be on his arm and on his right eye: his arm will be completely withered and his right eye totally blinded.

answers.text: His arm will be withered and his right eye blinded
He will be sold as a bondservant in Egypt
His flock will be doubled in the land
He will be driven out beyond the Jordan
